#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string rs;
    std::getline(std::cin, rs);
    std::string s = rs.substr(1, rs.size() - 2);
    int length = s.length();
    std::string result;
    result += rs[0];
    int index = 0;
    bool found_at = false;
    while (index < length) {
        if (index + 3 <= length) {
            if (s.substr(index, 3) == "dot") {
                result += ".";
                index += 3;
                continue;
            }
        }
        if (index + 2 <= length && !found_at) {
            if (s.substr(index, 2) == "at") {
                result += "@";
                found_at = true;
                index += 2;
                continue;
            }
        }
        result += s[index];
        index++;
    }
    result += rs[rs.size() - 1];
    std::cout << result << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
